name: laostay
description: LaoStay — backend API + WebAdmin + ເວັບລູກຄ້າ, ແລ່ນພ້ອມກັນດ້ວຍຄຳສັ່ງດຽວ

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix webadmin install && npm --prefix webapp install && npm --prefix backend run db:generate
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix webadmin run typecheck && npm --prefix webapp run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix webadmin run build && npm --prefix webapp run build
